title: Lobster Caesar Salad with Garlic
description:
Bon Appétit | August 1998
This one is delicious made with shrimp and/or scallops, too. If using lobster, garnish the plates with the empty shells.
ingredients: 2 large hearts of romaine, cut lengthwise in half
2 cups coarsely grated peeled celery root or parsnips
Garlic-Lemon Croutons (1 tbsp great lemon peel)
Puree all ingredients in blender. (Can be made 1 day ahead. Chill.)
directions: Cook lobsters in large pot of boiling salted water until just cooked through, about 12 minutes. Using tongs, transfer lobsters to large bowl; cool. Working over bowl, remove meat from tails and claws; reserve 1/4 cup lobster juices from bowl. Cut tail meat in half lengthwise. Whisk reserved juices into dressing; season with salt and pepper.

Arrange half of 1 romaine heart on each of 4 plates. Toss celery root with enough dressing to coat; mound on lettuce. Top with lobster meat; drizzle with dressing. Garnish each salad with grated Parmesan cheese and 3 croutons.
